_source: Ministry of Education / Curriculum Development Centre, Zambia — 'Civic Education (Forms 1-4) Syllabus - Scope, Content, Sequence & Curriculum Analysis Grids', Form 3 rows (items 46-60 of the document's Scope and Sequence Overview table, identified by the table's column-position markers for the Form 3 colour key). The source document is authored/compiled by a named individual, whose name, title and contact details have been removed — this file contains no identifying information, per this app's standing content policy of crediting only CDC/Ministry of Education. As with civic_education_form1.json, this scope-and-sequence table gives only a Topic, Sub-Topic/Unit and a brief 'Key Content Focus' phrase per row (no numbered CDC 'Specific Competence' outcome codes) — competency statements below are a direct paraphrase of each row's Key Content Focus into standard competency-statement form, not verbatim official CDC outcome text. The source document also contains a more detailed 'Curriculum Analysis Grid' section per form (learning strategies, assessment, materials) not used for this ingestion pass. No week-level pacing was available (only term).

subject.name: Civic Education
subject.description: Ordinary Level Secondary Civic Education syllabus, Form 1-4 (Curriculum Development Centre).

grade.name: Form 3
grade.phase: Secondary — the source scheme itself uses "Form 3" for this level under the 2023 CBC.

sub_topics.name: 3.1.1 Concept & Effects of Corruption
sub_topics.description: Types of corruption; effects on economy and society.

competencies.description: Explain the types of corruption and their effects on the economy and society

sub_topics.name: 3.1.2 Methods to Fight Corruption
sub_topics.description: Whistle blowing, sensitisation, advocacy, zero tolerance.

competencies.description: Describe methods to fight corruption (whistle blowing, sensitisation, advocacy, zero tolerance)

sub_topics.name: 3.1.3 Institutions Fighting Corruption
sub_topics.description: Anti-Corruption Commission, Auditor General's office, etc.

competencies.description: Identify institutions that fight corruption (Anti-Corruption Commission, Auditor General's office)

sub_topics.name: 3.2.1 Substance Abuse
sub_topics.description: Categories (over-the-counter, controlled); classifications (depressants, stimulants, hallucinogens); reasons; effects; self-control.

competencies.description: Classify categories of substance abuse and explain their reasons, effects, and the importance of self-control

sub_topics.name: 3.2.2 Institutions Fighting Substance Abuse
sub_topics.description: Drug Enforcement Commission, Transparency International Zambia, Zambia Police.

competencies.description: Identify institutions that fight substance abuse (Drug Enforcement Commission, Transparency International Zambia, Zambia Police)

sub_topics.name: 3.3.1 Family
sub_topics.description: Importance of family; types (nuclear, extended, single, child-headed); types of marriage (civil/statutory, customary); marriage contract; building strong relationships.

competencies.description: Explain the importance and types of family and marriage, and describe how to build strong family relationships

sub_topics.name: 3.3.2 Elements of Family Law
sub_topics.description: Marriage, divorce, death; factors causing family crisis.

competencies.description: Explain elements of family law (marriage, divorce, death) and factors causing family crisis

sub_topics.name: 3.4.1 Child Abuse - Forms & Protection
sub_topics.description: Concept; forms (sexual abuse, defilement, child marriage, harassment); protecting oneself (assertiveness, boundaries); addressing abuse (legislation, sensitisation).

competencies.description: Identify forms of child abuse and explain how to protect oneself and address abuse through legislation and sensitisation

sub_topics.name: 3.4.2 Teenage Pregnancies
sub_topics.description: Causes (peer pressure, lack of sex education); effects (dropout, suicide); promoting good morals.

competencies.description: Explain the causes and effects of teenage pregnancies and ways of promoting good morals

sub_topics.name: 3.5.1 Concept & Types of Culture
sub_topics.description: Meaning; types (material, non-material); indigenous culture; One Zambia One Nation.

competencies.description: Explain the meaning and types of culture, including indigenous culture and the One Zambia One Nation motto

sub_topics.name: 3.5.2 Cultural Diversity & Heritage
sub_topics.description: Obstacles to diversity; institutions preserving cultural heritage; national values.

competencies.description: Identify obstacles to cultural diversity and institutions that preserve cultural heritage and national values

topics.name: 3.6 Civil Society and Media in Governance

sub_topics.name: 3.6.1 Civil Society in Governance
sub_topics.description: Definition; classes (international, pressure groups, civic organisations); conditions for establishment; characteristics (non-profit); roles (defend democracy, civic education).

competencies.description: Explain the classes, characteristics and roles of civil society organisations in governance

sub_topics.name: 3.6.2 Media in Governance
sub_topics.description: Using different media to express oneself; responsible online communication.

competencies.description: Use different media responsibly to express oneself, including responsible online communication

sub_topics.name: 3.7.1 Debt Management
sub_topics.description: Debt relief; debt crisis (borrowing beyond capacity); effects of debt crisis on Zambia; financial discipline.

competencies.description: Explain debt relief and the causes and effects of a debt crisis, and practise financial discipline

sub_topics.name: 3.8.1 Entrepreneurial Activities
sub_topics.description: Establishing a business (producing goods, buying stock, selling services); recording business transactions (sales, purchases, working capital).

competencies.description: Describe how to establish a business and record business transactions (sales, purchases, working capital)
